div.div: 4 اسحر (tropical:) He was, or became, in the time called the سَحَر; (S, A, K;) as also ↓ استحر . (TA.) And (tropical:) He went, or journeyed, in the time so called: (S, K, TA:) or he rose to go, or journey, in that time; and so ↓ استحر : (TA:) or this latter signifies he went forth in that time. (A. [See also 1, last sentence.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
